scientific_contract: All S2 materials, histories, representations, sink schedule, root fractions, closure, dt, horizon, identity checks and 1e-10 cm water-ledger gate remain unchanged.

only_changed_validation_rule.reason: That fixed O(epsilon) check ignores the forward error of repeated accumulation and was not an operation-count-aware arithmetic integrity test.
only_changed_validation_rule.replacement: Validate the actual binary64 root accumulator against the exact prescribed binary64 Heun increment using a standard gamma_N forward-error bound derived before execution.

arithmetic_derivation.route_rate: r_route = numpy sum of the frozen retained-layer sink vector
arithmetic_derivation.route_rate_reference: r_fsum = math.fsum of the same frozen retained-layer sink vector
arithmetic_derivation.route_rate_bound: abs(r_route-r_fsum) <= gamma(m-1)*sum(abs(q_i)), where m is retained-layer count
arithmetic_derivation.heun_root_increment: x = fl(0.5*dt*(r_route+r_route)); because the prescribed sink is constant and independent of state, the root-ledger component receives the same binary64 x at every transaction
arithmetic_derivation.cumulative_reference: math.fsum of N copies of x
arithmetic_derivation.interpretation: This is an arithmetic forward-error bound, not a hydrological tolerance and not selected from the failed S2 magnitude.

pass_rules: root fractions sum to one within unchanged 64-epsilon arithmetic guard
math.fsum prescribed layer sink equals Tp within unchanged 64-epsilon arithmetic guard
numpy route sink sum differs from math.fsum only within gamma(m-1) layer-summation bound
final cumulative root ledger differs from math.fsum(N copies of binary64 Heun root increment) only within the preregistered gamma(N) cumulative bound
PRESCRIBED_ROOT and GENERIC_SINK observation trajectories are bit-identical
zero PRESCRIBED_ROOT and legacy no-sink trajectories are bit-identical
all four route water ledgers remain <= 1e-10 cm

decision_rule.fail: STOP_BEFORE_DYNAMIC_FEEDBACK; classify without modifying scientific inputs or arithmetic derivation.
